properties.name: app.security.totp-encryption-key
properties.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES key that encrypts authenticator secrets at rest.

properties.name: app.telegram.api-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Telegram Bot API that receives support messages.

properties.name: app.telegram.bot-token
properties.description: Token of the Telegram bot that posts support messages. Support messages are refused while it is empty.

properties.name: app.telegram.chat-id
properties.description: Id of the Telegram chat that receives support messages.
